The most recent estimates (2024‑2025) put the **average (mean) house price in California at roughly $750,000–$800,000**.  
- The median price (the middle value when all homes are sorted) is a bit lower, around **$700,000**.  
- The mean is pulled up by a handful of very expensive properties, so it sits a few tens of thousands higher than the median.

If you need a more precise figure for a specific county or time period, let me know and I can pull the latest data from the California Association of Realtors or the U.S. Census Bureau.
